serverInfo.description: MCP server for querying Loki logs via logcli
serverInfo.name: loki-query-server

from.description: Start timestamp in UTC (e.g. '2023-01-01T12:00:00Z'). Relative time expressions like '1h ago' are not supported. Use ISO 8601 format.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return. Maximum value is 1000

output.description: Output format - valid values are 'default' (formatted log lines), 'raw' (unprocessed log lines), or 'jsonl' (JSON Lines format). Note: values like 'text' or 'json' are not supported.

to.description: End timestamp in UTC (e.g. '2023-01-01T13:00:00Z'). Relative time expressions like 'now' are not supported. Use ISO 8601 format.

label.description: Label name to get values for
